lead.headline: COP31 COLLAPSES WITHOUT A DEAL
lead.summary: Nearly 200 countries fail to agree a climate declaration after record overtime, as the EU and about 130 nations reject a text with no fossil-fuel phase-out language. Small island states blame Saudi-led resistance; the first COP to end with no deal since 2009.

second_leads.headline: Trump dares Iran to test the blockade: “They’ll all be at the bottom of the sea”
second_leads.summary: Trump says he is inclined to resume strikes after the New Year if no deal is reached, as 14 Iranian tankers gather near Kharg Island.

second_leads.headline: Democrats clinch House majority of at least 258 seats
second_leads.summary: The largest House majority since 1992, surpassing the 2018 gains, after the 3 November midterms.
